arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
src=$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-leads-two-admin-release.XXXXXX)
bundle=/opt/telegram-robot-leads/.telegram-leads-release-35bd9851a6fe06f6ef750862e24ca00e18162f13.tgz
trap 'sudo -n rm -f -- "$bundle"; rm -rf -- "$src"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$src"
test "$(git -C "$src" rev-parse HEAD)" = "35bd9851a6fe06f6ef750862e24ca00e18162f13"
git -C "$src" --no-pager diff --check HEAD
sudo -n -H /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s "$src/tests" -q
python3 -B - "$src" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util,sys,tarfile
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("installer",root/"scripts/deploy_project_only.py")
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
for required in ("scripts/organic_growth.py","scripts/member_groups.py","scripts/safe_runtime.py"):
 assert required in mod.RUNTIME_FILES
assert len(mod.RUNTIME_FILES)==len(set(mod.RUNTIME_FILES))
with tarfile.open(root/"runtime.tgz","w:gz") as tar:
 for name in mod.RUNTIME_FILES:
  source=root/name
  assert source.is_file() and not source.is_symlink()
  tar.add(source,arcname=name,recursive=False)
print("BUNDLE_RUNTIME_FILE_COUNT",len(mod.RUNTIME_FILES),flush=True)
PY
sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 600 "$src/runtime.tgz" "$bundle"
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 -B "$src/scripts/deploy_project_only.py" --bundle "$bundle" --commit "35bd9851a6fe06f6ef750862e24ca00e18162f13" --expected-installed "06651386feaccbd528378aae4fc1469751afa57d"
sudo -n env PM2_HOME=/root/.pm2 pm2 jlist | python3 -c 'import json,sys; rows=json.load(sys.stdin); leads=[j for j in rows if j.get("name")=="telegram-robot-leads"]; other=[j for j in rows if j.get("name")=="iptvpn_bot"]; assert len(leads)==1 and len(other)==1 and leads[0]["pm2_env"]["status"]=="online" and other[0]["pm2_env"]["status"]=="online"; print("OTHER_BOT_RESTARTS_BEFORE",other[0]["pm2_env"]["restart_time"]); print("DEPLOY_PREFLIGHT_OK")'
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 -B "$src/scripts/deploy_project_only.py" --bundle "$bundle" --commit "35bd9851a6fe06f6ef750862e24ca00e18162f13" --expected-installed "06651386feaccbd528378aae4fc1469751afa57d" --apply --confirm-telegram-only
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 -B /opt/telegram-robot-leads/scripts/project_hygiene.py --apply --confirm-telegram-only
sudo -n env PM2_HOME=/root/.pm2 pm2 restart telegram-robot-leads
sudo -n env PM2_HOME=/root/.pm2 pm2 jlist | python3 -c 'import json,sys; rows=json.load(sys.stdin); leads=[j for j in rows if j.get("name")=="telegram-robot-leads"]; other=[j for j in rows if j.get("name")=="iptvpn_bot"]; assert len(leads)==1 and len(other)==1; p=leads[0]["pm2_env"]; assert p["status"]=="online" and p["pm_exec_path"]=="/opt/telegram-robot-leads/main.py" and p.get("TELEGRAM_REGIONAL_PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_ENABLED")=="1"; assert other[0]["pm2_env"]["status"]=="online" and other[0]["pm2_env"]["restart_time"]==0; print("PROJECT_WORKER_ONLINE",p.get("status"),"RESTARTS",p.get("restart_time")); print("OTHER_BOT_NOT_RESTARTED",other[0]["pm2_env"]["restart_time"])'
test "$(sudo -n cat /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.verified-source-commit)" = "35bd9851a6fe06f6ef750862e24ca00e18162f13"
sudo -n -H /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B /opt/telegram-robot-leads/scripts/leads_operational_report.py --expected-source "35bd9851a6fe06f6ef750862e24ca00e18162f13" --with-pm2 | python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(sys.stdin); assert r["source"]["matches_expected"] and r["pm2"]["status"]=="ONLINE" and r["sessions"]["accounts"]==2; print("REPORT_SOURCE_EXACT",True,"SESSIONS",r["sessions"]["accounts"],"GROWTH",r["organic_growth_model"].get("status"))'
echo TWO_ADMIN_OPTIN_RELEASE_DEPLOYED
